description: At times \(0,\ldots,6\) on input \(2\), the successor state and head pairs are \((\mathrm{scan},0),(\mathrm{scan},1),(\mathrm{scan},2),(\mathrm{back},1),(\mathrm{back},0),(\mathrm{back},-1),(\mathrm{halt},0)\). The tape is \(t_2\) at time \(2\), and is \(t_3\) at every time from \(3\) onward.
